design_source.identical_to_template: datasets, split_seed, outer_folds, outer_repeats, inner_folds, fit_seeds, candidate_budget, candidate_seed, candidate_tie_rule, stochastic_finalists, selection_metric, failure_policy, aggregation_integrity, freeze_requirement, paired_interval, parallelism, confidence, test_train_ratio, numeric_threads_per_worker, report_metrics, device, historical_results, full_method

removed_from_template.augmentation: the trained model's augmentation rule; nothing is trained here
removed_from_template.internal_validation_ratio: the trained model's checkpoint; nothing is trained here
removed_from_template.knn_readout: the trained model's readout block and its reference to the bridge run; the controls' readout is training_controls.readout and their reference is training_controls.reference

full_method.resolution: embed_dim=clip(round(base*embed_scale),8,128); degree=max(1,base+degree_offset) lowered while comb(n_features+degree,degree)>10000; augment=base_augment and n_train>=150; resolved at fit time from the training partition only

resource_decision: Task 20A (ruling 2026-09-13, training controls design): drafted from bridge_knn.json with the identical nested design; prepare 2026-09-13T09:37:49Z at c10966bf9 (7 datasets); compare_runs training-pairing against arrowflow-v3-bridge-knn-1 passed (7 datasets, fitting seeds [8129, 19391, 39019], 13 shared sealed sources identical); synthetic smoke 2026-09-13T09:37:52Z ok (reference, both controls, reporting, compare_runs training); training-only pilot 2026-09-13T09:38:28Z (iris, digits, segment; both controls at 3 candidates each on the first outer training partition; every fit ok; slowest fit 3.23 s arrowflow_knn_untrained, 2.24 s input_footrule_knn) projected 6.40 serial h, 0.40 h at 16 workers (harness max-based) and 2.35 serial h, 0.15 h at 16 workers calibrated on the realized non-training seconds (fit minus network training plus predict) of every arrowflow_full_knn fit of the reference run under 16 workers (45 fits per outer fold for the untrained control, 33 for the input control); cap 3 h at 16 single-thread workers; frozen after the pilot

training_controls.candidate_source: full_method.candidate_grid (the 16 candidates of arrowflow_full_knn) projected onto each model's candidate_keys; duplicates removed; canonical config_id order (knn_controls.control_candidates)
training_controls.comparison: python -m experiments.make_revision.compare_runs training --training-source <this run> --knn-source <reference run> --output <directory>; compare_runs training-pairing checks the prepared directory against the reference before the run

contrasts.interval: fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the 15 outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio, 14 df)
contrasts.members: per dataset in panel order: arrowflow_full_knn minus arrowflow_knn_untrained, then arrowflow_full_knn minus input_footrule_knn
contrasts.multiplicity: one Holm adjustment across all 14 members (evaluation.holm_adjust)
contrasts.pairing: identical datasets, dataset_hash, splits_hash, outer schedule, fit_seeds and nested design keys; both runs re-verified with the harness validators before any contrast; every source both environment records seal byte-identical (compare_runs.SHARED_SOURCES among them); each control's candidates are the projection of the reference arrowflow_full_knn candidates
contrasts.trained_source: arrowflow_full_knn outer model rows of the reference run (summary.json model_rows, re-verified); not refitted

depth_split.definition: per dataset, arrowflow_full_knn minus arrowflow_knn_untrained accuracy (fitting seeds averaged within fold), grouped by the hidden widths arrowflow_full_knn selected in that outer fold; per group the folds, n, mean, SD, min, max and the corrected resampled t interval over the group's folds when n >= 2; pooled across datasets per group: n, mean and SD
depth_split.status: descriptive; outside the Holm family; no p values

dropped.augment: the resolved augmentation acts only on training samples
dropped.validation_ratio: the validation checkpoint acts only during training

arrowflow_knn_untrained.network: view v's network is ArrowFlowEstimator.initialize_orders with seed derive_seed(fit seed, "view", v): the seeded initial filters arrowflow_full_knn starts training from; no training update of any layer (update_iter 0 checked after every fit)

dropped.augment: the resolved augmentation acts only on training samples
dropped.validation_ratio: the validation checkpoint acts only during training

input_footrule_knn.representation: inverse positions of each view's encoded input ranking; the encoders of MultiViewFootruleKNN and arrowflow_full_knn (same derived view seeds and strategy cycle)

readout.selection: mean accuracy over StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=derive_seed(view_seed, "readout_selection")) splits of the training partition inside every fit; fewer splits only if the smallest class has fewer rows; one neighbour cache per split at the largest k; ties lowest_canonical_config_id; refit on the full training representation
readout.source: identical to arrowflow_full_knn (bridge_knn.json knn_readout): multiview.select_knn_readout inside every fit, outside the candidate budget; the untrained control reuses MultiViewArrowFlowKNN._fit_view_readout

reference.run: .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-12-arrowflow-story-restoration-plan/runs/2026-09-12-bridge-knn (735 jobs, 105 of them arrowflow_full_knn; summary.json model_rows hold the per-fold, per-seed outer metrics)

training_controls.resolution: embed_dim and degree as full_method.resolution, from the training partition's shape at fit time (bridge.resolve); the resolved augment is dropped
